name: Luang Prabang
about: Cool-dry season Nov–Feb is most pleasant, hot season Mar–May is intense, monsoon Jun–Oct brings frequent rain.
overview: A UNESCO-listed royal capital of gilded temples and saffron-robed monks at the confluence of the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers.
costOverview: Food, coffee, and the night market are extremely cheap — hiring a tuk-tuk out to the waterfalls is the main real expense most visitors budget for.
